    # children of v, evaluated at label x. None represents all ones.

        total_cells = m * n

        top = total_cells - 2
        choose_k = k - 2
        factorial = [1] * (top + 1)
        for i in range(1, top + 1):
            factorial[i] = factorial[i - 1] * i % MOD

        combinations = (
            factorial[top]
            * pow(factorial[choose_k], MOD - 2, MOD)
            % MOD
            * pow(factorial[top - choose_k], MOD - 2, MOD)
            % MOD
        )
